# `web/` — generated by `flutter create --platforms=web`

After running `flutter create --platforms=web --project-name cairn_mobile .`,
edit `web/index.html` to add the MediaPipe GenAI script tag **before** the
Flutter loader. `flutter_gemma` won't initialize on the web target without it.

In the `<head>` block, add:

```html
<script type="module">
  import {
    FilesetResolver,
    LlmInference,
  } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-genai@0.10.27';
  window.FilesetResolver = FilesetResolver;
  window.LlmInference = LlmInference;
</script>
```

Pin the MediaPipe version (`0.10.27` here). Newer minors have shipped breaking
API changes mid-2025; bump deliberately.

## CORS / model hosting

The default model URL points at HuggingFace direct (`/resolve/main/<file>`).
HF serves with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` for raw blob downloads, but if
you mirror to your own bucket (Cloudflare R2, S3, etc.) you must:

1. Set `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` (or your origin).
2. Enable byte-range requests (`Accept-Ranges: bytes`) — MediaPipe streams the
   model with range gets, OPFS storage in `WebStorageMode.streaming` mode
   relies on this.

## Recommended Chrome launch for development

```bash
flutter run -d chrome \
  --web-browser-flag=--enable-unsafe-webgpu \
  --web-browser-flag=--enable-features=Vulkan \
  --web-browser-flag=--disable-web-security  # only for local dev w/ alt model hosts
```

Drop `--disable-web-security` for production builds.
